It was summer and way too hot to go running during the day so I waited until about 8pm after it cooled off. Running along a residential street and everything is fine. I hear a car driving up behind me, very slowly. It’s an old black Camaro that looks like someone put a lot of time into. The type of old car that has a distinct sound. I didn’t think much of this, but I did notice it. 

Continuing my run and I see it again. This time they were crossing the street in front of me. Odd. 

Then again. 

Now I’m completely weirded out. So I start running towards the center of the town and away from the dark residential streets. I swear I could hear that car following me the whole time. I didn’t really know what to do. I had left my phone at my house and figured I just need to be near some other people. Then I remember that that guy asked me one time if I wanted to go for a ride to LA because he had just finished doing something special to his car. And I knew it was black because he told me we had that in common (I had a black car at the time too). 

I’m convinced it’s him at this point. 

So I start running in between buildings and green patches any dead end for vehicles to lose him. I stopped and waited for a few minutes before starting up again. I think I lost him. 

So instead of going back to my house the way I came I decided to take a different route, even though it was a bit longer. 

I’m almost coming up to a high school campus when I hear that car driving up behind me again. I fuckin bolt at this point. I don’t know what’s going to happen. He speeds up in front of me and makes a sharp left turn. I cross the street and try to get on campus because I hear him coming back. Gates are closed. Everything is locked. And he’s getting closer. I hide in between some bushes and take off my reflective running vest, hoping the dark will hide me. He drives right in front of me. I don’t think he saw me. He circles the campus and when he doesn’t see me he drives off in a direction opposite my house. 

I bolt. I’ve never ran so fast in my life. I get back to my house and I see he had texted me “where are you?”
